description: Unit tests for NetworkChangeNotifierFuchsia, testing network interface changes, IP address changes, and connection types using a fake Fuchsia network interface watcher.

classes.name: FakeWatcher
classes.description: Fake implementation of fuchsia.net.interfaces/Watcher for testing, supporting event queueing and binding.

classes.name: FakeWatcherAsync
classes.description: Runs FakeWatcher in a separate thread, providing asynchronous interface for tests.

classes.name: ResultReceiver
classes.description: Template class to collect and verify received events or connection types.

classes.name: FakeConnectionTypeObserver
classes.description: Observer that records connection type changes for verification.

classes.name: FakeNetworkChangeObserver
classes.description: Observer that records network change events for verification.

classes.name: FakeIPAddressObserver
classes.description: Observer that records IP address change events for verification.

methods.name: CreateNotifier
methods.description: Sets up NetworkChangeNotifier with a fake watcher, optionally requiring WLAN and simulating disconnection.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, flushing watcher thread and processing pending events.
